issue_request: FHIR-28414 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked the core Questionnaire page to explain when it is appropriate to profile Questionnaire versus creating a Questionnaire instance, and when to profile QuestionnaireResponse versus defining a Questionnaire.

Later adjacent reconciliations for FHIR-28305 and FHIR-37550 are already present on the combined branch and do not alter this issue's design rule.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current notes still explain that profiles constrain sets or capabilities across Questionnaires/QuestionnaireResponses, while the content of a specific form belongs in a Questionnaire instance and form-specific responses should be represented through Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse linkage.
